source_query: arXiv API：cs.RO，以及标题或摘要命中同一组关键词的 cs.CV / cs.LG。关键词覆盖四足与腿式操作、移动操作、抓取、全身控制、视觉伺服、手眼标定、模仿学习、diffusion policy、VLA、遥操作、sim2real。只保留发布落在回溯窗口内、且没有出现在更早 data/arxiv_raw 文件中的条目。本文件是未解读候选，不是每日解读。
api_query: (submittedDate:[202611210429 TO 202611280429]) AND (cat:cs.RO OR cat:cs.CV OR cat:cs.LG) AND (all:quadruped OR all:quadrupedal OR all:"legged manipulation" OR all:"legged manipulator" OR all:"loco-manipulation" OR all:locomanipulation OR all:"loco manipulation" OR all:"mobile manipulation" OR all:"mobile manipulator" OR all:"whole-body control" OR all:"whole body control" OR all:"visual servoing" OR all:"visual servo" OR all:"hand-eye" OR all:"hand eye calibration" OR all:"imitation learning" OR all:"diffusion policy" OR all:"vision-language-action" OR all:"vision language action" OR all:VLA OR all:teleoperation OR all:"tele-operation" OR all:sim2real OR all:"sim-to-real" OR all:"sim to real" OR all:"robotic grasping" OR all:"grasp detection" OR all:"object grasping" OR all:"grasp pose")
